question: How can I track my order?
answer: You can track your order in real-time by visiting the 'My Orders' section in your account dashboard and clicking 'Track Package'. You will also receive an email and SMS with your courier tracking link once your order is dispatched.

question: Can I cancel or modify my order after placing it?
patterns: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Orders can be modified or canceled within 30 minutes of placing them directly from your 'Order History' page. If the order has already been processed or shipped, you can initiate a return once the package arrives.

question: What are your shipping options and delivery times?
answer: We offer Standard Delivery (3-5 business days) and Express Delivery (1-2 business days). Delivery times may vary slightly based on your postal code and courier schedule.

question: Do you offer free shipping?
patterns: Delivery charges and free shipping threshold
answer: Yes! Standard shipping is free on all orders over $49. For orders below $49, a flat standard shipping fee of $4.99 applies.

question: What is your return and refund policy?
patterns: How do I return an item?
Money back guarantee and return window
How many days to return a product?
answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy on unused items in their original packaging. Once our warehouse inspects the returned item, your refund will be processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

question: How do I request a replacement for a damaged item?
patterns: My order is damaged, what should I do?
answer: If your item arrived damaged or defective, please navigate to 'Returns & Replacements' in your account, select the item, and upload a photo of the damage. We will dispatch a free replacement within 24 hours.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
patterns: Can I pay with credit card or PayPal?
Do you accept Apple Pay, Google Pay, or debit cards?
answer: We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and UPI. All transactions are protected with 256-bit SSL encryption.

question: Why was my payment declined?
patterns: Why did my transaction not go through?
answer: Payments can be declined due to incorrect CVV/expiry date, insufficient funds, or bank fraud prevention triggers. We recommend contacting your issuing bank or trying an alternative payment method like PayPal.

question: How do I reset my account password?
answer: Click on 'Sign In', select 'Forgot Password', and enter your registered email address. You will receive a secure password reset link valid for 15 minutes.

question: How do I enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)?
patterns: How to protect my account with 2FA
answer: Go to 'Account Settings' > 'Security' > 'Two-Factor Authentication', and click 'Enable'. You can link an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy) or set up SMS verification codes.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can reach our 24/7 customer support team via Live Chat on our website, email us at support@example.com, or call toll-free at 1-800-555-0199 (Mon-Fri, 9am - 8pm EST).

question: How do I apply a coupon or promo code?
answer: On the checkout page, enter your promo code into the 'Discount / Promo Code' box and click 'Apply'. The discount will immediately reflect in your order total. Note that only one promo code can be used per order.

question: Do products come with a warranty?
answer: All electronic products include a minimum 1-year manufacturer warranty covering hardware defects. You can also purchase optional extended protection plans (2 or 3 years) during checkout.

question: What are your business hours?
answer: Our online store is open 24/7/365. Our customer support team is available Mon-Fri 9 AM - 8 PM EST and Sat-Sun 10 AM - 6 PM EST.
